LanguageData.LP_Cerebrum.label: brain matter metabolism
LanguageData.LP_Cerebrum.description: The origin of the mind flayer. Provides the "brain matter" resource bar (0-100): losing 8 per day, replenished only by devouring brains. Below 30 brain matter it starts to weaken, below 10 it's severely debilitated, and at zero it falls into brain hunger and may go into an uncontrolled frenzy. Devouring a downed humanlike gives (20+3×Intellectual level)×its psychic sensitivity brain matter (up to 80) and absorbs 20% of the XP of its highest skill; animals give only 3-10; fresh humanlike corpses dead within 6 hours give a third.
LanguageData.LP_Cerebrum.customEffectDescriptions.0: Max brain matter 100, losing 8 per day; weak below 30, debilitated below 10, brain hunger at zero (brain hunger frenzy can be turned off in mod settings).
LanguageData.LP_Cerebrum.customEffectDescriptions.1: Devouring a brain: humanlike (20+3×Intellectual)×psychic sensitivity, up to 80; animals 3-10; fresh humanlike corpses within 6 hours give a third.
LanguageData.LP_Cerebrum.customEffectDescriptions.2: Devouring destroys the target's brain: trolls won't revive, and the corpse is no longer intact. Liches and necromantic constructs have no living brain; mechanoids and the psychically deaf can't be devoured.
LanguageData.LP_Cerebrum.resourceDescription: The brain matter mind flayers live on. Loses 8 per day, replenished by devouring brains; psychic abilities also consume brain matter.
LanguageData.LP_MindFlayerSterile.label: mind flayer sterility
LanguageData.LP_MindFlayerSterile.description: Mind flayers can't reproduce. New mind flayers can only come from tadpole ceremorphosis.
LanguageData.LP_PsionicSense.label: psionic sense
LanguageData.LP_PsionicSense.description: Mind flayers can naturally hear the whispers of minds around them, and their own mind is like a wall: mind resistance +30%, resists others' charm, psychic blasts and parasites; can also read minds actively.
LanguageData.LP_HiveLink.label: hivemind link
LanguageData.LP_HiveLink.description: Mind flayers' minds are connected to each other. For each additional mind flayer of your faction on the same map, psychic sensitivity +10% and global learning speed +5%, counting up to 3. When a companion dies, the other mind flayers feel "hivemind severed".
LanguageData.LP_HiveLink.customEffectDescriptions.0: Each mind flayer companion of your faction on the same map: psychic sensitivity +10%, global learning speed +5% (up to 3).
